domains.name: Mesh Geometry Diagnostics
domains.scope: Diagnose indexed triangle edge orientation, per-corner UV signed area, and explicitly ordered three-dimensional point transforms.

skills.name: triangle-shared-edge-winding-check
skills.description: Inspect indexed triangle winding across shared edges when adjacent faces may traverse their common edge in the same direction.

skills.name: uv-triangle-signed-area-inspection
skills.description: Measure per-corner UV triangle signed areas when collapsed mappings or orientation changes need localization without assuming mirrored islands are errors.

skills.name: pivoted-3d-transform-composition
skills.description: Trace pivoted three-dimensional scale and rotation through a parent affine transform when operation order or coordinate space may explain misplaced geometry.
